<pnml>
  <net id="original-net" type="http://www.pnml.org/version-2009/grammar/pnmlcoremodel">
    <page id="original-page">
      <place id="source">
        <name>
          <text>Original source</text>
        </name>
        <initialMarking>
          <text>1</text>
        </initialMarking>
      </place>
      <place id="sink">
        <name>
          <text>Original sink</text>
        </name>
      </place>
      <transition id="original-transition-0">
        <toolspecific tool="ProM" version="6.4" activity="$invisible$" />
      </transition>
      <transition id="original-transition-1">
        <name>
          <text>A</text>
        </name>
      </transition>
      <transition id="original-transition-2">
        <toolspecific tool="ProM" version="6.4" activity="$invisible$" />
      </transition>
      <transition id="original-transition-3">
        <toolspecific tool="ProM" version="6.4" activity="$invisible$" />
      </transition>
      <arc id="in-0" source="source" target="original-transition-0">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="in-1" source="source" target="original-transition-1">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="in-2" source="source" target="original-transition-2">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="in-3" source="source" target="original-transition-3">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="out-0" source="original-transition-0" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="out-1" source="original-transition-1" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="out-2" source="original-transition-2" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
      <arc id="out-3" source="original-transition-3" target="sink">
        <inscription>
          <text>1</text>
        </inscription>
      </arc>
    </page>
    <finalmarkings>
      <marking>
        <place idref="sink">
          <text>1</text>
        </place>
      </marking>
    </finalmarkings>
  </net>
</pnml>
